description: Early medieval hanging lantern, lit: round cage of hammered, pitted black iron ~0.16 m across and ~0.36 m tall to the top of its hanging ring: dished base, eight straps, riveted bands, thin amber rippled glass panes you can see through, a conical cap pierced with quatrefoils, ring and link; a pillar candle inside whose flame is the light. Origin at its base: place the base at the hanging height under a beam.

paint.prompt: hammered, pitted black hand-forged iron with soot and small rust spots, worn dark grey on the edges and rivet heads; a pale cream wax candle
